note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
summary: Genesis locates the terebinths of Mamre at Hebron. Abram settles there and builds an altar to Yahweh.

senses.definition: The place at Hebron whose terebinths mark Abram’s campsite.

evidence.note: Abram settles by the terebinths of Mamre. The clause אֲשֶׁר בְּחֶבְרוֹן places them at Hebron.
